end.summary:
Practised reading and writing 4-digit numbers in words and numerals.
Used place-value boxes for hundreds, tens, and ones.
Read 2,335 correctly as “do hazaar teen sau paintalees” and wrote 2335.
Mixed up the role of zero in 3,042 and did not yet retain the empty-place value after correction.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised place value by separating thousands, hundreds, tens, and ones, then combining the parts. Diya correctly formed 42 from 4 tens and 2 ones after discussion, and wrote 2,335 correctly. They mixed up the zero in 3,042, treating it as having no role; this was not corrected by the last example. At home, practise numbers such as 4,050 and 3,042 by saying each place aloud, including “zero tens” or “zero hundreds.”
